_description: Default concordance mapping WIOD NIOT/WIOT (Nov16) ISIC Rev.4 sector codes to ABM model sectors. Each code must appear in exactly one model sector. Adjust for your region and research question.
_concordance_notes: retail is intentionally broader than trade (G47) alone.
(furniture/other consumer goods) are mapped to retail rather than manufacturing
because these sectors have large direct household final demand in the WIOT
(households buy food, clothing, and furniture produced by these sectors).
Treating them as retail captures ~20 percentage points of the global household

Trade-off: these sectors also have intermediate uses (food manufacturers supply
restaurants; clothing manufacturers supply workwear buyers). Those intermediate
flows are preserved in input_recipe_ranges — the retail sector will show intra-
sector supply links and purchases from agriculture and components.
Sectors left in manufacturing (C16-C18, C25-C30, C33, F) are predominantly
intermediate-goods producers with small direct household final demand.
